records.context: The Toxoplasma hyperLOPIT-to-SL mapping follows Einar Olafsson's Starplast ``celldiagram.py`` (MIT, revision 53703bafdf0604576a05b589400051a6b09e62ea). Artwork is by Philippe Le Mercier, SIB, CC BY 4.0; source records accompany the SVGs. Only the rendered copy loses hidden metadata and its credit logo; the original asset and visible attribution are retained. No PyQt6 import, network request or measured localization data is involved.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.organism_diagram#1
records.source: The Toxoplasma hyperLOPIT-to-SL mapping follows Einar Olafsson's Starplast ``celldiagram.py`` (MIT, revision 53703bafdf0604576a05b589400051a6b09e62ea). records.translation: Vörpun Toxoplasma hyperLOPIT yfir í SL fylgir Starplast ``celldiagram.py`` eftir Einar Olafsson (MIT, útgáfa 53703bafdf0604576a05b589400051a6b09e62ea). Myndefnið er eftir Philippe Le Mercier, SIB, CC BY 4.0; heimildaskrár fylgja SVG-skjölunum. Falin lýsigögn og höfundarmerki eru aðeins fjarlægð úr birtingarafritinu; upprunalegt tilfang og sýnileg höfundartilvísun haldast. Enginn innflutningur á PyQt6, netbeiðni eða mæld staðsetningargögn koma við sögu.

record.context: Each record supplies a display name, description, biology source URL, bundled diagram filename and diagram note. ``sections`` contains heading, prose and linked assay-structured-data name triples; ``links`` contains display-label and URL pairs. ``modules`` contains route-structured-data name, title, description and icon-structured-data name tuples. A ``None`` route denotes a planned assay whose tile cannot start an analysis. Display prose is translated at use; route structured-data names, URLs and asset names stay fixed.
record.label: spacr.qt.organisms.ORGANISMS#1
record.source: Each record supplies a display name, description, biology source URL, bundled diagram filename and diagram note. ``sections`` contains heading, prose and linked assay-key triples; ``links`` contains display-label and URL pairs. ``modules`` contains route-key, title, description and icon-key tuples. A ``None`` route denotes a planned assay whose tile cannot start an analysis. Display prose is translated at use; route keys, URLs and asset names stay fixed.
record.translation: Hver færsla gefur upp birtingarnafn, lýsingu, URL líffræðilegrar heimildar, skráarnafn meðfylgjandi skýringarmyndar og athugasemd um hana. ``sections`` inniheldur þrenndir með fyrirsögn, texta og tengdum próflyklum; ``links`` inniheldur pör með birtum tenglatexta og URL. ``modules`` inniheldur runur með leiðarlykli, titli, lýsingu og táknlykli. Leið með gildinu ``None`` táknar fyrirhugað próf sem ekki er hægt að keyra með reitnum. Birtingartexti er þýddur við notkun; leiðarlyklar, URL og nöfn tilfanga haldast óbreytt.
